messages:
Maya CSM: FYI — Equinox renewal questions. Olivia says procurement insists on vendor code + PO before they can release funds. They also want a 6mo term instead of our proposed 9mo. Can we make a plan?
Olivia Equinox: Confirmed — procurement is blocking us. They need vendor code (for their AP), PO number, and the DocuSign link. They asked if we can do Net30 invoice payment.
Jorge Finance: Vendor code ok, but we need the billing entity to match the PO. Which entity is on the contract? If they need Net30 we'll need approval for the payment terms.
Maya CSM: @Jorge Finance billing entity is Redwood Inc. (US). @Lena Legal is ok with amendment verbiage on term change?
Lena Legal: We can do a 6mo amendment but want a rollback clause for price at next renewal. Also need to keep SOW unchanged. I'll draft language: "6-month term amendment; price parity preserved; automatic reversion to original term at next renewal unless otherwise agreed."
Ravi AM: If we shorten to 6mo we should offer a small prorated tech credit — say 10% off first invoice — to keep them happy. Approve? :+1: / :thinking:
Jorge Finance: 10% credit is fine as a one-time concession. Need sign-off from Sales leadership for precedent; cc'ing Ravi. Also need PO before we apply credit.
Maya CSM: Sending DocuSign envelope and DocSend link now. docsend-bot: "Equinox renewal packet uploaded: https://docsend.example/s/eqx-renewal-2187654321"
Maya CSM: DocuSign envelope ID: 0a1b2c3d - routing to Olivia for signature, then to Redwood legal. Please don't modify the contract PDF.
Olivia Equinox: I can sign after procurement sends PO and vendor code. Their PO team asked if we can accept a PDF PO attached to the DocuSign envelope.
Lena Legal: We can accept an attached PO PDF, but need the PO number reflected in the invoice reference. Also please confirm EU VAT is not applicable (customer is US).
Olivia Equinox: Confirmed — US entity, no VAT. PO will include vendor code and PO number.
Maya CSM: Great. @Jorge Finance once PO arrives we'll match billing entity and email invoice Net30 with one-time 10% credit.
Jorge Finance: Roger. Please upload PO to the Salesforce contract record and mark "PO received". I'll generate invoice once that's in.
Ravi AM: Quick note on pricing: if Sales leadership wants to avoid precedent we can make the 10% credit explicitly as a one-time onboarding credit linked to this amendment only.
Lena Legal: Agreed. I'll add a single-line amendment clause: "Customer will receive a one-time onboarding credit equal to 10% of the first invoice for the amended term; credit is non-recurring."
Maya CSM: Timeline? Olivia, when do you expect procurement to send PO?
Olivia Equinox: They said by EOD tomorrow if we push them. I'll ping procurement now.
Maya CSM: Perfect. If PO arrives tomorrow I'll route DocuSign immediately and ask Finance to invoice same day.
Olivia Equinox: Pinged procurement — they replied with vendor code 7-5-2 and said "will issue PO by tomorrow EOD".
Maya CSM: Awesome. Closing loop: once PO uploaded to SF, Jorge will create invoice Net30 with 10% one-time credit; DocuSign will be routed for signature with Lena on final sign-off. Thanks everyone. :tada:
